open_task_policy: Accept independently verified alternative constructions, counterexamples, and unexpected results. Explicit additional-hypothesis results are legitimate contributions but must not be relabeled as completion of the original scope. A short proof using applicable standard theorems is fully acceptable. Honest incompleteness is distinct from an invalid proof.
required_evidence: Give a non-circular invariant or tower criterion equivalent to ordinary Ab_U representability for every allowed tower; prove necessity and sufficiency and identify all representing groups up to isomorphism.
Classify preservation of all diagrams with countably many objects and arrows, and establish its precise relation to the representability classification.
Describe every group-valued natural transformation between two tower functors and its identity and composition law.
critical_errors: Treat the transition maps or maps into the filtered colimit as injective without proof.
Replace arbitrary finite-rank free stages by a fixed rank, a bounded-rank tower, or eventually invertible transitions and claim a complete classification.
Infer finite generation of a possibly uncountable group from a single sequence without first establishing countability in this task.
Infer ordinary representability from finite-limit preservation alone, or identify a pro-object with an ordinary abelian group.
Claim M tensor - is Hom(M,-) rather than using the finite free dual, or reverse the direction of the natural transformation classification.
Use coordinate-dependent stages as one common stage for an infinite family.
completion_policy: A complete criterion M = colim Hom(P_n,Z) finite-rank free, with both directions, the countable-limit equivalence, and Nat(F_P,F_Pprime) = Hom(M_P,M_Pprime), suffices. Any equivalent non-circular tower criterion and correct alternative proof is acceptable. The finite-stage retract criterion, single-product test, finite-limit proof, and examples in the reference are optional. A lone counterexample to universal representability does not complete the new classification task.
